verdict.rationale: Patent Center documents a sponsorship model in which practitioners can sponsor support staff to prepare filings, and corresponding practitioners can access those saved submissions. That is a first-party delegated rail for third parties acting on filings, but the evidence covers it only in a single thin mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registered practitioners/attorneys as authorized representatives acting for a company, how a company designates or revokes a representative, trademark-side representative or designee rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Sponsored support staff will be able to prepare and save an AIR Form for submission. Corresponding Practitioners can access the saved submission
